title: Calendar
description: Adds a craftable calendar that shows the real-world date.
body:
# Calendar
Craft a calendar that displays the real-world date using 8 paper and a clock (analagous to the map recipe):  
![Calendar Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/56d6992a1f92df97fea24f6e0229fd73438771fb_0.webp)

Calendar is readable in the inventory, or by placing in an item frame:
![The calendar in an item frame](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/09177874941f78ed3f05e7d9892ac63b54b2eef9.png)
